title: Material Blend 2-Mix Trio #21 (대각 띠 3구역·물결 / 가로 띠 3구역·매끈 / 동심원 3구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 2 different materials repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 33% of the way down her figure from the top and about 54% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, butterfly swarm formations in ELECTRIC INDIGO and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC SILVER scale formations, VIVID PALE BLUE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
